thread:
sara liu: paging oncall — high rate of container restarts in g4-rt5 prefill pool, multiple customers seeing 5xx. incident-bot: @oncall triggered P0 (prefill memory surge) at 02:12 UTC
omar khan: I'm on it, seeing repeated CUDA OOMs during prefill path. stack shows allocation spikes at sequence length ~130k tokens.
oncall-bot: Pager duty: @omar khan is the primary oncall for infra.
jin park: metrics — prefill_restarts spiked from 0.01/s to 0.9/s across 4 nodes in us-west1.
ryan cole: any customer impact? dashboards show error-rate ~28% for text-generation route in prod-us-west.
dani vasquez: @sara can you confirm whether Dedicated customers are affected?
sara liu: Dedicated customers on reserved pools unaffected, this is hosted g4-rt5 prefill nodes handling large-context demos.
omar khan: logs (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-15T02:11:59Z] runtime error: CUDA error: out of memory when allocating 12.3 GiB
[2026-03-15T02:12:00Z] container runtime: prefill failed, killing container (OOMKilled)
[2026-03-15T02:12:01Z] kubelet: Pod restarted: inference-runtime-ff8c (node=g4-rt5-12)
```
ops-bot: Notifying infra-sre rotation.
alice mendez: I'm starting node-level inspection — pulling dmesg and GPU memory snapshots.
omar khan: short-term mitigations: 1) route large-context requests to fallback smaller model (quantized), 2) enable prefill-trim heuristic (trim long prefixes > 64k tokens), 3) increase eviction aggressiveness for KV cache. Rolling these now.
ryan cole: how do we route traffic to fallback model? canary policy or global?
jin park: will update route policy: canary on 10% then ramp to 100% for prefill requests > 48k tokens.
omar khan: applying hotpatch to runtime to cap prefill allocation per-request to 8 GiB — quick compile and rollout.

sara liu: commands I'm running for visibility:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=g4-rt5
kubectl logs -n inference <pod> -c runtime --since=5m
kubectl describe node g4-rt5-12
```

alice mendez: dmesg shows GPU driver reset events and EBUS errors around the restarts. Looks like memory fragmentation after repeated large prefill allocations.
dani vasquez: customer comms — support queue has ~12 high priority tickets referencing hangs/5xx on long prompts. @sara can you draft a short notice?
sara liu: drafting now: "We're investigating elevated errors for very large context requests in US-West. A mitigation is in place — requests will be routed to a smaller model or temporarily trimmed. We're monitoring and will update within 30 minutes."
omar khan: hotpatch rolled to 30% of g4-rt5 pool; prefill allocation cap active. Restart rate dropped by ~60% on patched nodes.
jin park: metrics update: error-rate down from 28% to 9% on routed traffic; overall cluster errors down ~45%.
ryan cole: rolling node cordon for 2 worst nodes to evacuate and reprovision (g4-rt5-12, g4-rt5-19).

alice mendez: cordon/drain commands used:
```
kubectl cordon g4-rt5-12
kubectl drain g4-rt5-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

omar khan: plan for next hour: 1) continue routing large contexts off the pool, 2) replace 3 nodes with fresh images (clear driver state), 3) push runtime patch with better prefill trimming / fragmentation mitigation, 4) run load test for 48k/96k token demos.
dani vasquez: customer update sent at 02:32 UTC — included link to status page and workaround (reduce prompt length or use smaller model).
ops-bot: Incident commander assigned: sara liu.
sara liu: assigning followups: @omar run root cause triage, @alice take node repro steps, @jin validate routing, @ryan coordinate infra reprovision. Postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC.
omar khan: note — we should consider adding a prefill memory accounting heuristic to reject or stream ultra-long prompts instead of full prefill. I'll add RFC.
ryan cole: infra has started replacing nodes; one node came back healthy after driver reboot + CUDA 13.1 rollback.
jin park: monitoring alert thresholds adjusted to avoid noisy pages for single-container flaps; we still page on >3 node restarts in 10m.
alice mendez: looking at customer logs — one heavy demo account sent 180 requests concurrently with huge contexts, we should rate limit demos in the hosted playground to prevent blast radius.
sara liu: summary for now: hotpatch and routing reduced impact, nodes being replaced, customer comms sent, postmortem scheduled. Will hand off to oncall rotation for continued monitoring.
oncall-bot: Handoff: primary oncall @omar khan -> secondary @jin park at 03:00 UTC.
omar khan: endorsing handoff, I'll be available if escalation needed.

sara liu: final note — need to capture exec summary (customers affected, percent requests failed, mitigations). Draft: "approx 12 customers impacted, peak error rate 28%, mitigations (routing, prefill cap, node replacement) reduced errors to 9%. Follow-ups: prefill memory accounting RFC, demo rate limit, stable runtime patch."
ryan cole: thanks team — continuing monitoring until next update window. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident closed for paging at 03:05 UTC (still in mitigation mode).
